summary: FND-01 local foundation only: pinned strict TypeScript Hono Node/Worker entry points, disposable PostgreSQL 17.11, actual pg/Kysely query and rollback plus committed positive control in both Node and local workerd. Clean lockfile installation and npm run check passed: five tests, none skipped.

limitations: Local verification only; no hosted Hyperdrive pooling/cache, Neon/TLS, Cloudflare deployment, CPU or latency benchmark.
No authentication, project RBAC, product schema/migrations or feature handlers; health routes carry no private product data.
PostgreSQL uses disposable memory-backed synthetic data; this is not durability, recovery or concurrency evidence.
Worker compatibility date pinned to installed workerd-supported 2026-10-19; test-only rollback entry point is excluded from the normal build.
No Git repository existed, so there is no commit revision; package lockfile hash and exact environment are recorded in the evidence document.
UI and integrated acceptance remain separately owned and unverified.
